$comment: Local government firearm bylaw register (PRD Appendix A). A jurisdiction shows grey until its bylaw is digitised, reviewed by a second person and re-confirmed within 45 days. Regenerate with `npm run register:bylaws`; existing rows are kept.

provinceCounts.source: Province of British Columbia count, given by a person on 2026-10-20
provinceCounts.note: The register is built from the official boundary layers (ABMS), which on 2026-10-19 held 160 municipalities and 159 electoral areas. One jurisdiction differs; a person identifies it. Until then every jurisdiction stays grey unless its bylaw is reviewed, so the difference cannot make a spot green.
